articles.title: China votes to oust three generals from political advisory body
articles.summary: China's top political advisory body has voted to remove three generals, following the ousting of nine military officials from its legislature a week prior. This significant move by Beijing signals a major internal shake-up within the People's Liberation Army, possibly indicating an anti-corruption drive or power consolidation efforts impacting the nation's defence establishment.

articles.title: Iran war: Trump vows response after US embassy in Riyadh hit
articles.summary: Israel's military launched further strikes on Lebanon early Tuesday morning, targeting Iran-backed entities. This latest military action signifies escalating cross-border tensions and the volatile security situation in the Middle East. Understanding such developments is crucial for comprehending regional conflicts and international defence dynamics.
